G3416.name: Mnason
G3416.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G3416.brief: A Cypriot disciple who hosted Paul in Jerusalem.
G3416.short: Mnason, an early disciple from Cyprus, provided lodging for Paul and his companions when they arrived in Jerusalem.

G3477.name: Naggai
G3477.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
G3477.short: Naggai is mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus Christ as recorded in the Gospel of Luke.

G3486.name: Nahum
G3486.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
G3486.short: Nahum is mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus Christ as recorded in the Gospel of Luke.

G3488.name: Narcissus
G3488.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G3488.brief: Christian in Rome with a household
G3488.short: Narcissus was likely a wealthy Christian in Rome with a household of believers.

G3482.name: Nathanael
G3482.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G3482.brief: Disciple of Jesus, from Cana in Galilee.
G3482.short: Nathanael, also known as Bartholomew, was one of Jesus' twelve disciples, who was initially skeptical but later confessed Jesus as the Son of God.

G3412.name: Mitylene
G3412.brief: A city on the island of Lesbos visited by Paul
G3412.short: Mitylene, a city on the island of Lesbos where Paul's ship stopped on his way to Jerusalem (<ref="Act.20.14">Act.20.14</ref>).

G3460.name: Myra
G3460.brief: A city in Lycia where Paul's ship stopped
G3460.short: Myra was a city in Lycia, Asia Minor, where Paul's ship stopped on his journey to Rome as a prisoner.

G3465.name: Mysia
G3465.brief: A region in northwest Asia Minor visited by Paul
G3465.short: Mysia was a region in northwest Asia Minor (modern Turkey) that Paul and his companions passed through on his second missionary journey.

G3484.name: Nain
G3484.brief: A town in Galilee where Jesus raised a widow's son
G3484.short: Nain was a town in Galilee where Jesus raised a widow's son from the dead.

G3478.name: Nazareth
G3478.brief: The hometown of Jesus in Galilee
G3478.short: Nazareth was a village in Galilee where Jesus grew up, giving rise to His title "Jesus of Nazareth."
G3478.meaning: probably from netser, “branch, shoot” (compare Isaiah 11:1; Matthew 2:23)

G3496.name: Neapolis
G3496.brief: A port city in Macedonia visited by Paul
G3496.short: Neapolis was a port city in Macedonia where Paul landed on his first journey to Europe.
